1//! Setting document metadata.
2//!
3//! PDF allows for the inclusion of metadata in a PDF document. To do so in crate::third_party::krilla,
4//! you can simply create a [`Metadata`] object, set the data, and then include it
5//! in the document via [`Document::set_metadata`].
6//!
7//! [`Document::set_metadata`]: crate::third_party::krilla::document::Document::set_metadata
8use pdf_writer::{Finish, Pdf, Ref, TextStr};
9use std::cell::LazyCell;
10use xmp_writer::{LangId, Timezone, XmpWriter};
11
12use crate::third_party::krilla::configure::{PdfVersion, ValidationError};
13use crate::third_party::krilla::serialize::{SerializeContext, SerializeSettings};
14
15/// Metadata for a PDF document.
16#[derive(Default, Clone, Debug)]
17pub struct Metadata {
18    pub(crate) title: Option<String>,
19    pub(crate) description: Option<String>,
20    pub(crate) creator: Option<String>,
21    pub(crate) producer: Option<String>,
22    pub(crate) keywords: Option<Vec<String>>,
23    pub(crate) authors: Option<Vec<String>>,
24    pub(crate) document_id: Option<String>,
25    pub(crate) language: Option<String>,
26    pub(crate) creation_date: Option<DateTime>,
27    pub(crate) modification_date: Option<DateTime>,
28    pub(crate) text_direction: Option<TextDirection>,
29    pub(crate) page_layout: Option<PageLayout>,
30}
31
32impl Metadata {
33    /// Create new metadata.
34    pub fn new() -> Self {
35        Self { ..Default::default() }
36    }
37
38    /// The title of the document.
39    pub fn title(mut self, title: String) -> Self {
40        if !title.is_empty() {
41            self.title = Some(title);
42        }
43        self
44    }
45
46    /// The description of the document.
47    ///
48    /// This should be a short, human-readable abstract, summary, or description
49    /// of the topic of the document.
50    pub fn description(mut self, description: String) -> Self {
51        if !description.is_empty() {
52            self.description = Some(description);
53        }
54        self
55    }
56
57    /// The keywords that describe the document.
58    pub fn keywords(mut self, keywords: Vec<String>) -> Self {
59        if !keywords.is_empty() {
60            self.keywords = Some(keywords);
61        }
62        self
63    }
64
65    /// The main language of the document, as an RFC 3066 language tag.
66    ///
67    /// This property is required for some export modes, like for example PDF/A-3a.
68    pub fn language(mut self, language: String) -> Self {
69        self.language = Some(language);
70        self
71    }
72
73    /// The creator tool of the document.
74    pub fn creator(mut self, creator: String) -> Self {
75        if !creator.is_empty() {
76            self.creator = Some(creator);
77        }
78        self
79    }
80
81    /// The producer tool of the document.
82    pub fn producer(mut self, producer: String) -> Self {
83        if !producer.is_empty() {
84            self.producer = Some(producer);
85        }
86        self
87    }
88
89    /// The authors of the document.
90    pub fn authors(mut self, authors: Vec<String>) -> Self {
91        if !authors.is_empty() {
92            self.authors = Some(authors);
93        }
94        self
95    }
96
97    /// The creation date of the document.
98    pub fn creation_date(mut self, creation_date: DateTime) -> Self {
99        self.creation_date = Some(creation_date);
100        self
101    }
102
103    /// The date the document was last modified. Without it, the creation date is
104    /// written as the modification date.
105    pub fn modification_date(mut self, modification_date: DateTime) -> Self {
106        self.modification_date = Some(modification_date);
107        self
108    }
109
110    /// The date written as the modification date: the one given, else the creation date.
111    fn modified(&self) -> Option<DateTime> {
112        self.modification_date.or(self.creation_date)
113    }
114
115    /// A document ID.
116    ///
117    /// This attribute will be used as an identifier for identifying
118    /// different versions of the same document.
119    pub fn document_id(mut self, document_id: String) -> Self {
120        self.document_id = Some(document_id);
121        self
122    }
123
124    /// The main text direction of the document.
125    pub fn text_direction(mut self, text_direction: TextDirection) -> Self {
126        self.text_direction = Some(text_direction);
127        self
128    }
129
130    /// How the viewer should lay out the pages.
131    pub fn page_layout(mut self, page_layout: PageLayout) -> Self {
132        self.page_layout = Some(page_layout);
133        self
134    }
135
136    pub(crate) fn has_document_info(&self) -> bool {
137        self.title.is_some()
138            || self.producer.is_some()
139            || self.keywords.is_some()
140            || self.authors.is_some()
141            || self.creator.is_some()
142            || self.creation_date.is_some()
143            || self.modification_date.is_some()
144            || self.description.is_some()
145    }
146
147    pub(crate) fn serialize_xmp_metadata(&self, xmp: &mut XmpWriter, sc: &mut SerializeContext, instance_id: &str) {
148        if let Some(title) = &self.title {
149            xmp.title([(None, title.as_str())]);
150        }
151
152        if let Some(description) = &self.description {
153            xmp.description([(None, description.as_str())]);
154        }
155
156        if let Some(keywords) = &self.keywords {
157            let joined = keywords.join(", ");
158            xmp.pdf_keywords(joined.as_str());
159        }
160
161        match &self.authors {
162            Some(authors) if sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version() >= PdfVersion::Pdf20 => {
163                // PDF 2.0+ deprecates the document information dictionary, so
164                // we can use the array here.
165                xmp.creator(authors.iter().map(String::as_str));
166            }
167            Some(authors) => {
168                // Turns out that if the authors are given in both the document
169                // information dictionary and the XMP metadata, Acrobat takes a
170                // little bit of both: The first author from the document
171                // information dictionary and the remaining authors from the XMP
172                // metadata.
173                //
174                // To fix this for Acrobat, we could omit the remaining authors
175                // or all metadata from the document information catalog (it is
176                // optional) and only write XMP. However, not all other tools
177                // (including Apple Preview) read the XMP data. This means we do
178                // want to include all authors in the document information
179                // dictionary.
180                //
181                // Thus, the only alternative is to fold all authors into a
182                // single `<rdf:li>` in the XMP metadata. This is, in fact,
183                // exactly what the PDF/A spec Part 1 section 6.7.3 has to say
184                // about the matter. It's a bit weird to not use the array (and
185                // it makes Acrobat show the author list in quotes), but there's
186                // not much we can do about that.
187                let joined = authors.join(", ");
188                xmp.creator([joined.as_str()]);
189            }
190            None => {}
191        }
192
193        if let Some(creator) = &self.creator {
194            xmp.creator_tool(creator);
195        }
196
197        if let Some(producer) = &self.producer {
198            xmp.producer(producer);
199        }
200
201        if let Some(lang) = &self.language {
202            xmp.language([LangId(lang)]);
203        }
204
205        if let Some(date) = self.modified().map(xmp_date) {
206            xmp.modify_date(date);
207        }
208
209        if let Some(date) = self.creation_date.map(xmp_date) {
210            xmp.create_date(date);
211
212            if sc.serialize_settings().validators().requires_file_provenance_information() {
213                let mut history = xmp.history();
214                let mut saved = history.add_event();
215
216                saved.action(xmp_writer::ResourceEventAction::Saved).when(date);
217
218                if !sc.serialize_settings().validators().prohibits_instance_id_in_xmp_metadata() {
219                    saved.instance_id(&format!("{instance_id}_source"));
220                }
221
222                saved.finish();
223
224                let mut converted = history.add_event();
225
226                converted.action(xmp_writer::ResourceEventAction::Converted).when(date);
227
228                if let Some(creator) = &self.creator {
229                    converted.software_agent(creator);
230                }
231
232                if !sc.serialize_settings().validators().prohibits_instance_id_in_xmp_metadata() {
233                    converted.instance_id(&format!("{instance_id}_source"));
234                }
235            }
236        } else {
237            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::MissingDocumentDate);
238        }
239    }
240
241    pub(crate) fn serialize_document_info(&self, ref_: &mut Ref, pdf: &mut Pdf, settings: &SerializeSettings) {
242        let config = settings.configuration;
243        if config.validators().prohibits_info_dict() {
244            return;
245        }
246
247        if self.has_document_info() || settings.has_print_info(config.version()) {
248            let ref_ = ref_.bump();
249            let mut document_info = LazyCell::new(|| pdf.document_info(ref_));
250
251            // ALl of those are deprecated in PDF 2.0 and will only be written
252            // to the XMP metadata.
253            if config.version() < PdfVersion::Pdf20 {
254                if let Some(title) = &self.title {
255                    document_info.title(TextStr(title));
256                }
257
258                if let Some(description) = &self.description {
259                    document_info.subject(TextStr(description));
260                }
261
262                if let Some(keywords) = &self.keywords {
263                    let joined = keywords.join(", ");
264                    document_info.keywords(TextStr(&joined));
265                }
266
267                if let Some(authors) = &self.authors {
268                    let joined = authors.join(", ");
269                    document_info.author(TextStr(&joined));
270                }
271
272                if let Some(creator) = &self.creator {
273                    document_info.creator(TextStr(creator));
274                }
275
276                if let Some(producer) = &self.producer {
277                    document_info.producer(TextStr(producer));
278                }
279            }
280
281            if let Some(date_time) = self.modified() {
282                document_info.modified_date(pdf_date(date_time));
283            }
284
285            if let Some(date_time) = self.creation_date {
286                document_info.creation_date(pdf_date(date_time));
287            }
288
289            if settings.has_print_info(config.version()) {
290                settings.write_print_info(&mut document_info);
291            }
292        }
293    }
294}

296/// A datetime. Invalid values will be clamped.
297#[derive(Debug, Copy, Clone, Eq, PartialEq, Hash)]
298pub struct DateTime {
299    /// The year (0-9999).
300    pub(crate) year: u16,
301    /// The month (0-11).
302    pub(crate) month: Option<u8>,
303    /// The day (0-31).
304    pub(crate) day: Option<u8>,
305    /// The hour (0-23).
306    pub(crate) hour: Option<u8>,
307    /// The minute (0-59).
308    pub(crate) minute: Option<u8>,
309    /// The second (0-59).
310    pub(crate) second: Option<u8>,
311    /// The hour offset from UTC (-23 through 23).
312    pub(crate) utc_offset_hour: Option<i8>,
313    /// The minute offset from UTC (0-59). Will carry over the sign from
314    /// `utc_offset_hour`.
315    pub(crate) utc_offset_minute: u8,
316}
317
318impl DateTime {
319    /// Create a new, minimal date. The year will be clamped within the range
320    /// 0-9999.
321    #[inline]
322    pub fn new(year: u16) -> Self {
323        Self { year: year.min(9999), month: None, day: None, hour: None, minute: None, second: None, utc_offset_hour: None, utc_offset_minute: 0 }
324    }
325
326    /// Add the month field. It will be clamped within the range 1-12.
327    #[inline]
328    pub fn month(mut self, month: u8) -> Self {
329        self.month = Some(month.clamp(1, 12));
330        self
331    }
332
333    /// Add the day field. It will be clamped within the range 1-31.
334    #[inline]
335    pub fn day(mut self, day: u8) -> Self {
336        self.day = Some(day.clamp(1, 31));
337        self
338    }
339
340    /// Add the hour field. It will be clamped within the range 0-23.
341    #[inline]
342    pub fn hour(mut self, hour: u8) -> Self {
343        self.hour = Some(hour.min(23));
344        self
345    }
346
347    /// Add the minute field. It will be clamped within the range 0-59.
348    #[inline]
349    pub fn minute(mut self, minute: u8) -> Self {
350        self.minute = Some(minute.min(59));
351        self
352    }
353
354    /// Add the second field. It will be clamped within the range 0-59.
355    #[inline]
356    pub fn second(mut self, second: u8) -> Self {
357        self.second = Some(second.min(59));
358        self
359    }
360
361    /// Add the offset from UTC in hours. If not specified, the time will be
362    /// assumed to be local to the viewer's time zone. It will be clamped within
363    /// the range -23-23.
364    #[inline]
365    pub fn utc_offset_hour(mut self, hour: i8) -> Self {
366        self.utc_offset_hour = Some(hour.clamp(-23, 23));
367        self
368    }
369
370    /// Add the offset from UTC in minutes. This will have the same sign as set in
371    /// [`Self::utc_offset_hour`]. It will be clamped within the range 0-59.
372    #[inline]
373    pub fn utc_offset_minute(mut self, minute: u8) -> Self {
374        self.utc_offset_minute = minute.min(59);
375        self
376    }
377}
378
379/// Converts a datetime to a pdf-writer date.
380pub(crate) fn pdf_date(date_time: DateTime) -> pdf_writer::Date {
381    // We always assume a full date with all fields because for some reason
382    // Acrobat doesn't like PDF/A-1 files without everything set.
383    pdf_writer::Date::new(date_time.year)
384        .month(date_time.month.unwrap_or(1))
385        .day(date_time.day.unwrap_or(1))
386        .hour(date_time.hour.unwrap_or(0))
387        .minute(date_time.minute.unwrap_or(0))
388        .second(date_time.second.unwrap_or(0))
389        .utc_offset_hour(date_time.utc_offset_hour.unwrap_or(0))
390        .utc_offset_minute(date_time.utc_offset_minute)
391}
392
393/// Converts a datetime to an xmp-writer datetime.
394fn xmp_date(datetime: DateTime) -> xmp_writer::DateTime {
395    let timezone = match (datetime.utc_offset_hour, datetime.utc_offset_minute) {
396        (Some(h), m) => Some(Timezone::Local { hour: h, minute: m as i8 }),
397        _ => Some(Timezone::Utc),
398    };
399
400    // We always assume a full date with all fields because for some reason
401    // Acrobat doesn't like PDF/A-1 files without everything set.
402    xmp_writer::DateTime {
403        year: datetime.year,
404        month: Some(datetime.month.unwrap_or(1)),
405        day: Some(datetime.day.unwrap_or(1)),
406        hour: Some(datetime.hour.unwrap_or(0)),
407        minute: Some(datetime.minute.unwrap_or(0)),
408        second: Some(datetime.second.unwrap_or(0)),
409        timezone,
410    }
411}

413/// The main text direction of the document.
414#[allow(missing_docs)]
415#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
416pub enum TextDirection {
417    LeftToRight,
418    RightToLeft,
419}
420
421impl TextDirection {
422    pub(crate) fn to_pdf(self) -> pdf_writer::types::Direction {
423        match self {
424            TextDirection::LeftToRight => pdf_writer::types::Direction::L2R,
425            TextDirection::RightToLeft => pdf_writer::types::Direction::R2L,
426        }
427    }
428}

430/// How the viewer should lay out the pages.
431#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
432pub enum PageLayout {
433    /// Only a single page at a time.
434    SinglePage,
435    /// A single, continuously scrolling column of pages.
436    OneColumn,
437    /// Two continuously scrolling columns of pages, laid out with odd-numbered
438    /// pages on the left.
439    TwoColumnLeft,
440    /// Two continuously scrolling columns of pages, laid out with odd-numbered
441    /// pages on the right (like in a left-bound book).
442    TwoColumnRight,
443    /// Only two pages are visible at a time, laid out with odd-numbered pages
444    /// on the left. PDF 1.5+.
445    TwoPageLeft,
446    /// Only two pages are visible at a time, laid out with odd-numbered pages
447    /// on the right (like in a left-bound book). PDF 1.5+.
448    TwoPageRight,
449}
450
451impl PageLayout {
452    pub(crate) fn to_pdf(self) -> pdf_writer::types::PageLayout {
453        match self {
454            PageLayout::SinglePage => pdf_writer::types::PageLayout::SinglePage,
455            PageLayout::OneColumn => pdf_writer::types::PageLayout::OneColumn,
456            PageLayout::TwoColumnLeft => pdf_writer::types::PageLayout::TwoColumnLeft,
457            PageLayout::TwoColumnRight => pdf_writer::types::PageLayout::TwoColumnRight,
458            PageLayout::TwoPageLeft => pdf_writer::types::PageLayout::TwoPageLeft,
459            PageLayout::TwoPageRight => pdf_writer::types::PageLayout::TwoPageRight,
460        }
461    }
462}
